The Beekeeper 2 Teaser Trailer Sends Jason Statham to War With the Beekeepers

by Phil Sadsad | Oct 16, 2026

Updated: October 16, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:31
Instaread

The Beekeeper 2 sends Adam Clay against the rogue organization that trained him. The teaser shows a government takeover threat, President Jessica Danforth in danger, and brutal new action. Jason Statham returns with Jeremy Irons, while Timo Tjahjanto directs. The sequel officially opens in theaters worldwide on January 15, 2027.

What Does The Beekeeper 2 Teaser Trailer Reveal?

The Beekeeper 2 teaser sends Adam Clay into a bigger, deadlier fight than the first film. Jason Statham returns as the former operative, now facing the rogue Beekeeper group that trained him. Wallace Westwyld warns that the organization wants control of the government, while Clay is pulled back into action to protect President Jessica Danforth and clear his name.

Why Is Jason Statham’s Adam Clay Fighting the Rogue Beekeepers?

Image © 2026 Amazon MGM Studios

The footage opens with Clay watching a fire burn across a valley as a bee lands on his hand. Jeremy Irons returns as Wallace Westwyld and tells him the Beekeepers have “gone rogue.” The threat is no longer a single criminal network. This time, the organization itself has become the enemy.

  • Wallace’s warning: He tells Clay, “You’re the only one who can stop them.”
  • Government threat: The rogue Beekeepers want “complete control” of the government.
  • Wanted man: Deadline reports that Clay is a wanted man who must clear his name while fighting back.
  • President in danger: Jemma Redgrave returns as President Jessica Danforth. Sources confirm Clay must save her, but a kidnapping is not consistently confirmed.
  • New cast: Pom Klementieff, Yara Shahidi, and Adam Copeland join the sequel, though their exact roles remain secret.

Unlike the first movie’s revenge story, this sequel turns Clay’s organization against him. Pom Klementieff appears in authority, but the teaser does not confirm that she leads the rogue faction.

What Action Does The Beekeeper 2 Teaser Trailer Reveal Ahead of Its 2027 Release?

The teaser shifts quickly into large-scale action, with Metallica’s “For Whom the Bell Tolls” playing over the footage. Timo Tjahjanto directs the sequel, while Kurt Wimmer and Zak Penn are credited as writers. Amazon MGM Studios will release the movie in theaters worldwide on January 15, 2027.

  • Dodge Super Bee: Clay drives a 1969 Dodge Super Bee fitted with a machine gun-style weapon.
  • Flamethrower fight: One scene shows Clay turning a flamethrower attack back on an enemy.
  • Final joke: After the fight, Clay says, “Next time don’t be so hotheaded.”
  • Returning cast: Bobby Naderi and Jeremy Irons return alongside Statham and Redgrave.
  • Production: Jason Statham, Chris Long, and Kurt Wimmer are listed among the producers.

The teaser makes the sequel’s main conflict clear: Clay must fight the Beekeeper organization itself while protecting the government from a takeover.

Final Thoughts

The Beekeeper 2 builds on the first film’s success with a bigger government-level threat and more brutal action. The original earned about $162 million at the worldwide box office and scored 71% with critics on Rotten Tomatoes. The sequel is directed by Timo Tjahjanto and written by Kurt Wimmer and Zak Penn.

FAQs

Is Beekeeper 2 coming out?

Yes, The Beekeeper 2 is officially scheduled for a theatrical release in January 2027.

Where can I watch Beekeeper 2?

The Beekeeper 2 will first be available in theaters, with Amazon MGM Studios handling the theatrical release.

What date is Beekeeper 2 coming out?

The Beekeeper 2 opens in theaters on January 15, 2027.

Who is returning in The Beekeeper 2?

Jason Statham, Jeremy Irons, Jemma Redgrave, Emmy Raver-Lampman, and Bobby Naderi are among the returning cast members.

Who directs The Beekeeper 2?

Timo Tjahjanto directs the sequel, replacing first-film director David Ayer.
